caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object resembling an andiron, which is an iron support used for holding logs in a fireplace. It is oriented diagonally on a plain, off-white background with no other objects present. The andiron features a vertical, textured upright bar that terminates in a scroll at the top, and this vertical element is joined to two curved legs forming a stable base, each leg splaying outward in opposite directions. The main horizontal bar extends backward from the central join, ending in a squared-off foot, providing a sense of depth in the composition. The entire object is rendered in grayscale, showing detailed shading and texture of the metalwork, and the drawing is composed using fine lines and smooth gradations to emphasize the object's form and material.
title: Andiron
